item.title: Building a Loan Amortization Schedule in Google Sheets
item.description:
An amortization schedule shows, for every payment period, how much of a fixed payment goes to interest versus principal, and what the balance is afterward. Sheets has three built-in functions for this. Whether a particular rate or term is a good deal depends on numbers specific to an actual offer, which this post doesn’t touch.
